title: Fleetscope / Session
description: One session: how it ended, its actions, issues, resource use and network. Open it from the Sessions table so the time range fits the session.

target.rawSql:
-- Marks the end of every failed action on the three charts.
SELECT
    ts + toIntervalMillisecond(duration_ms) AS time,
    concat('#', toString(seq), ' ', action_type, ' ', target, ': ', ifNull(error_code, 'unknown')) AS text
FROM actions
WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
  AND NOT ok
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)

-- Marks every issue on the three charts.
SELECT
    ts AS time,
    concat(kind, ': ', message) AS text
FROM issues
WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Display status of the session: healthy, degraded (success with a failed action or an issue), failed (failed, timeout or crashed), blocked, running, or interrupted (Ctrl+C, not a failure). This panel's query also feeds What happened and Est. cost.

targets.rawSql:
-- Status, the one-sentence summary and the estimated cost of the session, from one pass over session-facts.
-- The panels "What happened" and "Est. cost" read their column from this result (Dashboard data source).
-- display_status: healthy, degraded (success with a failed action or an issue), failed, blocked, running, interrupted.
-- An unknown session id gives no row, so every panel shows its No value text.
WITH facts AS
(
    WITH
        picked AS
        (
            SELECT *
            FROM sessions FINAL
            WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
        ),
        issue_facts AS
        (
            SELECT session_id, count() AS issue_count, toString(argMin(kind, ts)) AS first_issue
            FROM issues
            WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM picked)
              AND ts >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM picked)
            GROUP BY session_id
        ),
        action_facts AS
        (
            SELECT
                session_id,
                count() AS actions,
                countIf(NOT ok) AS failed_actions,
                ifNull(argMinIf(error_code, seq, NOT ok), '') AS first_failed_code
            FROM actions
            WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM picked)
              AND ts >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM picked)
            GROUP BY session_id
        )
    SELECT
        p.session_id AS session_id,
        p.agent_id AS agent_id,
        p.source AS source,
        p.engine AS engine,
        p.routed_from AS routed_from,
        p.engine_version AS engine_version,
        p.provider AS provider,
        p.scenario AS scenario,
        p.started_at AS started_at,
        p.ended_at AS ended_at,
        p.status AS status,
        p.reason AS reason,
        p.duration_ms AS duration_ms,
        p.startup_ms + p.connect_ms AS time_to_browser_ms,
        (p.status = 'failed' AND ifNull(p.reason, '') = 'interrupted') AS is_interrupted,
        a.actions AS actions,
        a.failed_actions AS failed_actions,
        i.issue_count AS issue_count,
        multiIf(
            p.status = 'running', 'running',
            is_interrupted, 'interrupted',
            p.status = 'success' AND a.failed_actions = 0 AND i.issue_count = 0, 'healthy',
            p.status = 'success', 'degraded',
            p.status = 'blocked', 'blocked',
            'failed') AS display_status,
        if(p.status NOT IN ('running', 'success') AND NOT is_interrupted,
            multiIf(i.first_issue != '', i.first_issue, a.first_failed_code != '', a.first_failed_code, p.status),
            NULL) AS cause,
        if(cause IS NULL, NULL,
            multiIf(i.first_issue != '', 'issue', a.first_failed_code != '', 'action', 'status')) AS cause_from,
        (toUInt64(p.startup_ms) + p.connect_ms
            + ifNull(p.duration_ms, dateDiff('millisecond', p.started_at, now64(3)))) / 3.6e6 AS browser_hours,
        if(price.provider = '', NULL, browser_hours * price.usd_per_browser_hour) AS est_cost_usd
    FROM picked AS p
    LEFT JOIN issue_facts AS i ON i.session_id = p.session_id
    LEFT JOIN action_facts AS a ON a.session_id = p.session_id
    LEFT JOIN pricing_current AS price ON price.engine = p.engine AND price.provider = p.provider
),
    first_failed AS
    (
        SELECT
            count() AS n,
            min(seq) AS first_seq,
            argMin(action_type, seq) AS first_type,
            argMin(target, seq) AS first_target,
            argMin(ifNull(error_code, 'unknown'), seq) AS first_code,
            argMin(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) + duration_ms, seq) AS first_end_ms
        FROM actions
        WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}') AND NOT ok
    ),
    first_issue AS
    (
        SELECT count() AS n, argMin(toString(kind), ts) AS kind, argMin(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts), ts) AS at_ms
        FROM issues
        WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
    )
SELECT
    display_status,
    multiIf(
        display_status = 'running', 'Running',
        display_status = 'interrupted', 'Interrupted by the runner (not counted as a failure)',
        display_status = 'healthy', 'Completed, no issues',
        display_status = 'degraded' AND issue_count > 0,
            concat('Completed with ', toString(issue_count), if(issue_count = 1, ' issue: ', ' issues, the first: '), first_issue.kind),
        display_status = 'degraded',
            concat('Completed after ', toString(failed_actions), ' failed action(s): ', first_failed.first_code),
        display_status = 'blocked',
            concat('Blocked at ', concat(toString(intDiv((if(first_failed.n > 0, first_failed.first_end_ms, if(first_issue.n > 0, first_issue.at_ms, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(started_at) + duration_ms)) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(started_at)), 1000)), '.', leftPad(toString(intDiv((if(first_failed.n > 0, first_failed.first_end_ms, if(first_issue.n > 0, first_issue.at_ms, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(started_at) + duration_ms)) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(started_at)) % 1000, 10)), 2, '0')), ' s: ', cause,
                   if(first_failed.n > 0 AND first_failed.first_code != cause,
                      concat('; ', concat('action #', toString(first_failed.first_seq), ' ', first_failed.first_type, ' ', first_failed.first_target), ' failed: ', first_failed.first_code), '')),
        first_failed.n > 0,
            concat('Failed at ', concat(toString(intDiv((first_failed.first_end_ms - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(started_at)), 1000)), '.', leftPad(toString(intDiv((first_failed.first_end_ms - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(started_at)) % 1000, 10)), 2, '0')), ' s: ', concat('action #', toString(first_failed.first_seq), ' ', first_failed.first_type, ' ', first_failed.first_target), ', ', first_failed.first_code,
                   if(first_failed.first_code != cause, concat(' (cause: ', cause, ')'), '')),
        concat('Failed: ', ifNull(reason, 'no reason recorded'))) AS what_happened,
    ifNull(est_cost_usd, nan) AS estimated_cost_usd
FROM facts
CROSS JOIN first_failed
CROSS JOIN first_issue

panels.title: What happened
panels.description: One sentence built from the session's status, its first failed action, its first issue and its cause (from the Status query). The Actions and Issues tables show the detail.

defaults.noValue: Session not found. It may be older than 30 days, or the id is wrong.

panels.title: Engine
panels.description: The browser engine and its version. Not reported when the engine gives no version. A session routed by the fleet runner (ADR 0005) also says which engine it was first assigned to.

targets.rawSql:
-- Engine and its version (null = the engine does not report one); a routed session also says which engine was first chosen (routed_from).
SELECT concat(engine, ' ', ifNull(engine_version, 'version not reported'), if(routed_from IS NULL, '', concat(' (routed from ', routed_from, ')'))) AS engine_version
FROM sessions FINAL
WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')

panels.title: Source
panels.description: REAL = a real browser session. SIM = simulated data from the simulator.

targets.rawSql:
-- real or sim.
SELECT source FROM sessions FINAL WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')

panels.title: Duration
panels.description: Time from the start of the session to its end. Running while the session has not ended.

targets.rawSql:
-- Time from session start to session end. nan (printed "running") while the session has not ended.
SELECT ifNull(toFloat64(duration_ms), nan) AS duration_ms
FROM sessions FINAL
WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')

panels.title: Actions
panels.description: Browser actions of the session that succeeded and that failed.

targets.rawSql:
-- Actions of the session: how many succeeded, how many failed. A known session without actions says 0 ok, 0 failed.
SELECT concat(toString(a.ok_n), ' ok · ', toString(a.failed_n), ' failed') AS actions
FROM (SELECT session_id FROM sessions FINAL WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')) AS s
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT session_id AS a_id, countIf(ok) AS ok_n, countIf(NOT ok) AS failed_n
    FROM actions
    WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
    GROUP BY a_id
) AS a ON a.a_id = s.session_id

panels.title: Time to browser
panels.description: Startup plus connect: the time from no container to a browser the client can drive.

targets.rawSql:
-- Time to a usable browser = startup_ms + connect_ms.
SELECT toUInt64(startup_ms) + connect_ms AS time_to_browser_ms
FROM sessions FINAL
WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')

panels.title: Peak CPU
panels.description: Highest CPU sample of the container (Docker stats), as a percentage of one core. It can pass 100%.

targets.rawSql:
-- Highest container CPU sample (% of one core).
-- nan (printed "Not available") when the session has no such sample, no row when the session does not exist.
SELECT ifNull(p.peak, nan) AS peak
FROM (SELECT session_id FROM sessions FINAL WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')) AS s
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT session_id AS p_id, maxOrNull(cpu_pct) AS peak
    FROM resource_samples
    WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
      AND origin = 'container'
    GROUP BY p_id
) AS p ON p.p_id = s.session_id

panels.title: Peak memory
panels.description: Highest memory sample of the container (Docker stats), in MiB.

targets.rawSql:
-- Highest container memory sample (MiB).
-- nan (printed "Not available") when the session has no such sample, no row when the session does not exist.
SELECT ifNull(p.peak, nan) AS peak
FROM (SELECT session_id FROM sessions FINAL WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')) AS s
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT session_id AS p_id, maxOrNull(mem_mb) AS peak
    FROM resource_samples
    WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
      AND origin = 'container'
    GROUP BY p_id
) AS p ON p.p_id = s.session_id

panels.title: Peak JS heap
panels.description: Highest JS heap sample read through CDP. Not available when the engine does not report it (stored as null).

targets.rawSql:
-- Highest JS heap sample (MiB, CDP).
-- nan (printed "Not available") when the session has no such sample, no row when the session does not exist.
SELECT ifNull(p.peak, nan) AS peak
FROM (SELECT session_id FROM sessions FINAL WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')) AS s
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT session_id AS p_id, maxOrNull(js_heap_mb) AS peak
    FROM resource_samples
    WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
      AND origin = 'cdp'
    GROUP BY p_id
) AS p ON p.p_id = s.session_id

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Network requests recorded for the session. The collector samples requests, so this is not every request.

targets.rawSql:
-- Network requests recorded for the session (the collector samples them, so this is not every request).
SELECT r.n AS requests
FROM (SELECT session_id FROM sessions FINAL WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')) AS s
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT session_id AS r_id, count() AS n
    FROM network_requests
    WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
    GROUP BY r_id
) AS r ON r.r_id = s.session_id

panels.title: Est. cost
panels.description: Browser-hours × $0.10 per browser-hour (Browserbase's published price, from the `pricing` table). An estimate, not a bill. A running session counts until now. Not available when the session has no price (from the Status query).

panels.title: Actions
panels.description: The session's browser actions in order (at most 1000 rows). Start is the offset from the session start. Open the timeline in Perfetto for the full picture.

targets.rawSql:
-- The session's actions in order (at most 1000). start_ms is the offset from the session start.
SELECT
    seq,
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) - (SELECT toUnixTimestamp64Milli(started_at) FROM sessions FINAL WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')) AS start_ms,
    action_type,
    target,
    duration_ms,
    if(ok, 'ok', 'failed') AS result,
    error_code
FROM actions
WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
ORDER BY seq
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Timeline
panels.description: Opens the session timeline in Perfetto through the Fleetscope API. The trace is processed in your browser.

options.content:
Open timeline in Perfetto ↗

Actions, network and issues with CPU, memory and JS heap on one time axis. Opens ui.perfetto.dev; the trace stays in your browser.

panels.title: Issues
panels.description: Problems raised during the session (blocked, captcha, crash, timeout, nav_error, unsupported_api; at most 1000 rows). A successful session with an issue is degraded.

targets.rawSql:
-- Issues raised during the session (at most 1000). offset_ms is the time since the session start.
SELECT
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) - (SELECT toUnixTimestamp64Milli(started_at) FROM sessions FINAL WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')) AS offset_ms,
    kind,
    message
FROM issues
WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU of the session's container, measured outside the browser by Docker stats, as a percentage of one core. The range follows the session when you open it from the Sessions table. Marks: failed actions and issues.

targets.rawSql:
-- Container CPU samples (% of one core).
SELECT
    ts AS time,
    engine,
    cpu_pct
FROM resource_samples
WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
  AND origin = 'container'
  AND cpu_pct IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts

defaults.noValue: No samples in this range. Open the session from the Sessions table so the range fits it.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory of the session's container (Docker stats), in MiB. The range follows the session when you open it from the Sessions table. Marks: failed actions and issues.

targets.rawSql:
-- Container memory samples (MiB).
SELECT
    ts AS time,
    engine,
    mem_mb
FROM resource_samples
WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
  AND origin = 'container'
  AND mem_mb IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts

defaults.noValue: No samples in this range. Open the session from the Sessions table so the range fits it.

panels.title: JS heap
panels.description: JS heap read through CDP Performance.getMetrics, in MiB. A sample the engine failed to read leaves a gap in the line (never interpolated). Engines that do not support it store null and show no line.

targets.rawSql:
-- CDP JS heap samples (MiB). A NULL sample stays in the result, so the line breaks there; a session
-- without any real value (the engine does not report a heap) returns no rows.
SELECT
    ts AS time,
    engine,
    js_heap_mb
FROM resource_samples
WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
  AND origin = 'cdp'
  AND session_id IN (
      SELECT session_id FROM resource_samples
      WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}') AND origin = 'cdp' AND js_heap_mb IS NOT NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts

defaults.noValue: No JS heap samples: the engine doesn't report it (stored as null), or the range doesn't cover the session.

panels.title: Ask Grafana Assistant
panels.description: Suggested prompts for Grafana Assistant. Assistant is available on Grafana Cloud only.

options.content:
Grafana Assistant is available on **Grafana Cloud only**. Open it and paste a prompt; the session id is filled in.

- Why did session `${session}` fail? Start from the **What happened** panel and the first failed action.
- Was the page waiting or working when it failed? Compare CPU with the **Actions** table.
- Is this an engine limitation (`unsupported_api`, metrics that are **Not available**) or a problem with the site?
- Find other sessions in the last 24 hours with the same failure cause, and say which engines they ran on.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Network requests recorded for the session (at most 1000 rows). The collector samples requests, so this is not every request. Time is the offset from the session start. No response means the request failed before an answer arrived; not reported means the engine gave no size.

targets.rawSql:
-- Network requests recorded for the session (sampled), in order. offset_ms is the time since the session start.
-- status is null when the request got no response; bytes is null when the engine does not report it.
SELECT
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) - (SELECT toUnixTimestamp64Milli(started_at) FROM sessions FINAL WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')) AS offset_ms,
    domain,
    resource_type,
    status,
    bytes,
    duration_ms
FROM network_requests
WHERE session_id = decodeURLComponent('${session:percentencode}')
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 1000
